ver.errText: Try again. If it still does not load, send RightOne support the reference below.
ver.cursorTitle: This page of the list can no longer be used.
ver.noNetwork: Opening, recording or concluding an inspection needs the network. What you typed stays on the device. When the network returns, act again to send it.
ver.state.NOT_YET_IN_FORCE: Issued, not in force at the time checked
ver.state.NOT_YET_IN_FORCE_FROM: Issued, in force from {d}, not in force at the time checked
ver.state.REINSTATED: In force, reinstated after a suspension
ver.noAppointmentWhy: You hold no appointment in force at this moment.
ver.finding.RECORD_NOT_PRESENTED: No certificate presented at the time
ver.finding.EXTERNAL_LICENCE_PRESENTED: Licence granted outside the single window presented
ver.ack.REFUSED_TO_ACKNOWLEDGE: The representative declined to acknowledge the record
ver.followUp.RE_VISIT: To be inspected again before the date chosen
ver.followUp.AWAIT_REGISTRATION: Awaiting registration before the date chosen
refusal.NO_EFFECTIVE_APPOINTMENT: You hold no appointment in force, so you cannot inspect. Ask your authority to send your appointment to RightOne operations.
refusal.APPOINTMENT_SUSPENDED: Your appointment is suspended, so this cannot be done. Contact RightOne operations for the reason and how to have it reinstated.
refusal.AUTHORITY_NOT_ACTIVE: The inspection authority you act for is not designated, or its designation has ended, so nothing can be done in its name.
refusal.POLICY_READ_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not read the rules in force, so this cannot be done. Try again in 5 minutes.
refusal.NOT_AUTHORISED: Your account does not have the right to do this. If you need it, contact RightOne support.
refusal.APPOINTMENT_REQUIRED: You hold more than one appointment. Choose the authority you act for on the field client’s home screen, or in the "Authority" field when requesting a list, then send again.
refusal.KEYS_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not read the verification keys, so they were not refreshed or the result was not uploaded. The old keys and the waiting result stay on the device until you try again with a network.
refusal.DEVICE_TIME_IN_FUTURE: Your device’s check time is ahead of RightOne's clock, so this result cannot be uploaded. Turn on automatic date and time, then rescan the code if you are still at the premises, or discard the result.
refusal.PAYLOAD_UNREADABLE: The scanned code could not be read, so this result cannot be uploaded. Rescan the code if you are still at the premises, or discard the result.
refusal.ANSWER_NOT_FOUND: No verification answer with this reference can be used here. The reference may be wrong, past its retention, or under an appointment other than the one you act under.
refusal.PREMISES_READ_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not read what it needs from the register, so this cannot be done. Try again in 5 minutes.
refusal.PAYLOAD_REFERENCE_MISMATCH: The certificate reference sent does not match the QR code scanned. Rescan it. If it still does not match, type the printed reference. For an offline result, rescan while at the premises or discard it.
refusal.ANSWER_NOT_FOR_PREMISES: This verification answer is about another premises, so it was not attached to this inspection. It is still stored on its own. Scan the code on the certificate of the premises being inspected.
refusal.OUTSIDE_JURISDICTION: This premises or area is outside your authority’s recorded jurisdiction, so it cannot be inspected or listed.
refusal.JURISDICTION_NOT_RECORDED_FOR_GE: Your authority’s jurisdiction is not yet recorded under the administrative geography in force, so this cannot be done. RightOne operations has been told to record it again.
refusal.OBSERVED_OUTSIDE_AUTHORITY: At the time you give for the inspection, your appointment or your authority’s designation was not in force, so the inspection was not recorded. Check the time it took place.
refusal.ANSWER_OUTSIDE_INSPECTION_WINDOW: This verification was made too long before the inspection, so it cannot be attached as evidence. Verify the premises’ record again.
refusal.DELAY_REASON_REQUIRED: The inspection is being recorded after the time allowed, so give a reason for the delay. Nothing was saved.
refusal.OBSERVED_AT_IN_FUTURE: The time of the inspection cannot be later than now. Correct the time.
refusal.INSPECTION_NOT_FOUND: This open inspection was not found in your authority. Open the list of inspections and choose again.
refusal.INSPECTION_NOT_OPEN: This inspection has ended, so nothing can be added. Where a record was issued, its reference is below. A record is corrected only when the related case requires it.
refusal.NOTE_REQUIRED: This kind of finding needs a note. Nothing was saved.
refusal.PURPOSE_NOT_ADMITTED: This purpose is not allowed, so no inspection was opened. The purposes allowed are listed below.
refusal.LOCATION_CONTEXT_NOT_PERMITTED: A record carries the register address only, never the device's location or where a code was scanned. No inspection was opened.
refusal.REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is needed for this. Nothing was saved.
refusal.ABANDONMENT_NOT_PERMITTED: This inspection has a finding or a verification recorded, so it cannot be abandoned as opened in error. Conclude it with the outcome that fits.
refusal.PENALTY_ROUTE_NOT_IN_FORCE: During the pilot, inspection gives guidance only and makes no penalty referral. No record was issued. Choose "Refer for case follow-up" and issue the record.
refusal.OUTCOME_NOT_SUPPORTED: No attached verification shows the premises’ certificate or status record in force, so the outcome cannot be compliant. Verify and attach the answer first.
refusal.RECORD_NOT_CURRENT_AT_INSPECTION: The issuing authority’s data shows no certificate or status record in force for the premises when the inspection took place, so the outcome cannot be compliant. Choose another outcome.
refusal.OUTCOME_CONTRADICTS_FINDING: This outcome contradicts the finding named below. Choose an outcome that fits what was recorded.
refusal.GUIDANCE_MISSING: Write the guidance given to the premises. No record was issued.
refusal.REFERRAL_NOTE_MISSING: Write what is referred. No record was issued.
refusal.REPRESENTATIVE_ROLE_MISSING: Choose the role of the premises’ representative present, or record that nobody was present. No record was issued.
refusal.FOLLOW_UP_DATE_INVALID: Choose a follow-up date no earlier than the conclusion, then send again. No record or version was issued.
refusal.CASE_INTAKE_UNAVAILABLE: The case could not be opened and nothing was saved. Send it again. It will not be opened twice.
refusal.CERTIFICATE_READ_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not read the certificate authority’s data, so this cannot be done. Try again in 5 minutes.
refusal.NOT_ISSUING_AUTHORITY: Another authority issued this record, so only that authority can record its handover or a correction.
refusal.ALREADY_DELIVERED: This record has already reached the premises, so a second handover was not recorded. The route and time recorded are below.
refusal.HANDOVER_TIME_INVALID: The handover time must be after the record was issued and not later than now. Correct the time.
refusal.RECORD_NOT_FOUND: No inspection record with this reference was found. Check the reference printed on the record.
refusal.LIST_SUPPLY_LIMIT_REACHED: You have requested the number of lists allowed today, so this request was not recorded. You can request another from the time shown below, Vietnam time.
refusal.REGISTER_READ_UNAVAILABLE: The list could not be made because RightOne could not read the premises register, or the register has not defined the premises in scope. This attempt does not count toward today’s requests. Request it again later.
refusal.RECORD_READ_UNAVAILABLE: The list could not be made because RightOne could not read the certificate records. This attempt does not count toward today’s requests. Request it again later.
refusal.SCOPE_READ_UNAVAILABLE: The list could not be made because RightOne could not read the obligation decisions or the tariff scope. This attempt does not count toward today’s requests. Request it again later.
refusal.DECISION_READ_UNAVAILABLE: The list could not be made because RightOne could not read the decisions, payment deadlines or reported changes. This attempt does not count toward today’s requests. Request it again later.
refusal.GENERATION_TIMED_OUT: The list could not be made because generating it took longer than 15 minutes. This attempt does not count toward today’s requests. Request it again later.
refusal.SUPPLY_NOT_READY: This list is not ready, or could not be generated. If it could not be generated, request it again.
refusal.ENTRIES_DISPOSED: The entries of this list have passed their retention and were deleted, and only the summary remains. Request a new list if you need one.
refusal.SUPPLY_NOT_FOUND: This list cannot be found. Choose again from the lists of the period.
refusal.CURSOR_INVALID: This page of the list can no longer be used. Reload from the first page.

ver17.beyond: Open past the recording interval. Conclude it with a reason for late recording.

ver01.title: Verify a record
ver01.needsNetwork: Refreshing the keys needs the network.
ver01.expiringTitle: The verification keys stop working offline at {t}.
ver01.noKeysTitle: No verification keys on this device yet.
ver01.noKeysText: Connect once to download them before checking offline.
ver01.scanLabel: Scan the code on the certificate
ver01.cameraText: Allow it in the browser settings, or type the reference.
ver01.recordOffline: Opening a record needs the network.
ver01.prefixes: Prefixes: R1-CER-, CRP-, VRA-, IRC- or a premises reference
ver01.typedOffline: A typed reference needs the network. A scanned code can still be checked offline.
ver01.verifyWhy: Scan a code or type a reference first.
ver01.limited: Checked without a network: the code is authentic, the current status is not known
ver01.noKeyResult: This code cannot be checked offline, because the device holds no verification key for it or its keys are more than 7 days old.
ver01.dlgText: It has not been uploaded to RightOne and will be deleted from the device.
ver01.scanStandIn: Printout in front of the camera
ver01.scanStandInHelp: The web version has no camera. Type the printout reference, starting CRP-, to read the QR code printed on it.
ver01.offlineCheck: Check offline with the keys on this device
ver01.offlineCheckHelp: The result waits on the device and is uploaded when you choose Upload now.
ver01.noCode: No QR code could be read on printout {r}. Check the printout reference, or type the certificate's reference to look it up.
ver01.notAuthResult: The code could not be authenticated
ver01.notAttached: Stored, not attached to the inspection: {r}
ver02.superseded: This printout is out of date. The details above are those of the record in force.
ver02.statement: The code proves who issued the record. It does not prove where it was scanned.
ver02.notUploaded: This result has not been uploaded to RightOne.
ver02.refreshOff: Refreshing the keys needs the network.
ver02.willAttach: Attached to the inspection when uploaded
ver02.offlineHeading: Checked without a network: the code is authentic, the current status is not known
ver02.offlineBody: The code is unaltered. The details below are its status when printed ({p}). It may have been revoked or suspended since. The device’s keys were refreshed at {k}, Vietnam time.
ver02.keyRetired: Key {k} stopped signing at {t}, after this code was printed. The code still verifies under it.
ver02.outside: This premises is outside your authority’s jurisdiction, so only public details are shown. To have it inspected, refer it to the authority for that area.
ver02.unable: It could not be checked because a system did not answer. This is not a "no record" result. Try again in 5 minutes.
ver02.invalid: The reference is not in a valid format, or this kind cannot be looked up. Check it, or choose another kind.
ver02.offlineKeys: This code cannot be checked offline because the device's keys are missing or over 7 days old. This is not a "no record" result. When online, refresh the keys or type the certificate reference.
ver02.noRecord: No certificate or status record has this reference. That does not mean the premises is in breach. Check the reference. If the details are wrong, the premises contacts the one-stop gateway for music copyright.
ver02.noPremisesInJ: The register holds no premises with this reference in your authority’s jurisdiction. The register may be incomplete, so the premises may still be registered. Scan the code or type the certificate’s reference.
ver02.noCurrent: {p}, {a} holds no certificate or status record in force now. That does not mean the premises is in breach. Last known status: never issued.
ver02.noCurrentLast: {p}, {a} holds no certificate or status record in force now. That does not mean the premises is in breach. Last known status: {s}.
ver02.notAuth: This code could not be authenticated, so nothing it carries is shown. Type the reference printed on the certificate to check online.
ver02.ambiguous: This reference names {n} premises, so none was chosen. Scan the code or type the certificate reference of the premises you are inspecting.
ver03.title: Start an inspection
ver03.openExists: You already have an open inspection of this premises.
ver03.lastDay: After the last day of your appointment, an inspection opens only from a verification made before it.
ver03.offlineWhy: Opening an inspection needs the network.
ver04.printedState: Status when the code was printed ({d}): {s}. Not checked at the inspection
ver04.noteHelp: Needed for "Use beyond the certificate’s scope", "Licence granted outside the single window presented" and "Other".
ver04.lastDay: After the last day of your appointment, you can only record the visit already made. You cannot verify again.
ver04.emptyTitle: Verify the premises’ record, then record what you found.
ver04.offlineWhy: Recording or concluding an inspection needs the network.
ver04.dlgText: No record is issued. The inspection stays on file with your reason.

ver05.meta: Took place at {t}, more than 24 hours ago, so a reason for late recording is needed.
ver05.offlineWhy: Issuing the record needs the network.
ver05.dlgTitle: Issue the record of this inspection?
ver05.dlgText: It goes to the premises and cannot be changed afterwards, except by a correction a case’s decision requires.

ver05.offlineWaiting: The result {rep} checked offline for this inspection has not been uploaded.
ver05.askText: The result {rep} checked offline for this inspection has not been uploaded and will not be in the record.

ver06.handed: Handed over at the premises at {t}
ver06.onlyIssuing: Only the issuing authority reads the whole record.
ver06.offlineWhy: Recording the handover needs the network.
ver06.ack.REFUSED_TO_ACKNOWLEDGE: the representative declined to acknowledge the record
ver06.verifiedOffline: {a}: checked without a network. Status when printed ({p}): {s}. The current status and any revocation since were not checked. Verification keys refreshed at {k}
ver06.noticeDelivered: The notice reached the premises at {t}
ver06.supersededText: The content below is this version as it was issued. The version in force is the latest.

ver07.filteredText: Choose another kind or status, or clear the filters.

ver08.emptyTitle: No premises in these areas is listed.
ver08.endNote: Every entry is on this page.
ver08.copyWhy: Select an entry in the table first.
ver08.notRead: The register could not be read when it was generated
ver08.route.AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE: Register drawn from the authoritative source
ver08.route.ALTERNATIVE_ROUTE: Register drawn from the approved alternative route, because the authoritative source cannot be reached
ver08.route.MANUAL_ADMISSION: Premises admitted by hand, one at a time, with no population run completed
ver08.statement.NO_CURRENT_RECORD: This list names premises with no current certificate or status record in RightOne. Being listed is not a finding of breach. A premises may hold a lawful licence from outside the single window, or be awaiting its record.
ver08.statement.NOT_CURRENT_WITH_DECISIO: This list names premises whose certificate or status record is not yet in line with the obligation decision in force. Each entry is a change not yet decided or a record not yet updated, and does not reflect any act of the premises.
ver08.title: {ref} - {kind} - {areas}
refusal.SEGREGATION_REQUIRED: You recorded or suspended this, or it appoints you, so you cannot also approve or refuse it. Nothing was saved, and it waits for another approver.
refusal.NOT_PENDING_APPROVAL: This is no longer waiting for a decision, so your decision was not recorded. Reload the page to see where it stands.
refusal.AUTHORITY_NOT_FOUND: This inspection authority’s designation was not found. Go back to the list and choose again.
refusal.AUTHORITY_CODE_EXISTS: This authority code is already in use. Use another code.
refusal.AREA_NOT_IN_GEOGRAPHY: The area named below is not in the geography version chosen. Choose the area again.
refusal.GEOGRAPHY_READ_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not read the administrative geography, so nothing was recorded. Try again in 5 minutes.
refusal.END_DATE_IN_PAST: The end date cannot be before today.
refusal.END_DATE_EXTENDS_PERIOD: The end date cannot be later than the approved end date ({date}). To extend the period, record a new decision for approval.
refusal.DESIGNATION_NOT_ACTIVE: The inspection authority concerned holds no designation in force, so this cannot be done. Check its designation in the list of inspection authorities.
refusal.PERSON_NOT_FOUND: No person with this party reference is in the register, so no appointment was recorded. Check the appointee’s party reference.
refusal.APPOINTMENT_EXISTS: This person already holds an appointment of the same authority, in force or waiting for approval. Open the existing appointment.
refusal.APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND: This appointment was not found. Go back to the list and choose again.
refusal.APPOINTMENT_NOT_ACTIVE: This appointment is not in a status that allows this. Reload the page to see where it stands.
refusal.APPOINTMENT_NOT_SUSPENDED: This appointment is not suspended, so there is nothing to reinstate.
refusal.NOT_AUTHORISED_FOR_PREMISES: You are not recorded as acting for this premises, so you cannot see this or send a request. If you are its principal or delegate, check the list of representatives in the premises profile.
refusal.GROUNDS_MISSING: The grounds of the request are needed, at most 4,000 characters. No request was sent.
refusal.SUBJECT_NOT_FOUND: No answer or record has this reference, so no request was sent. Check the reference.
refusal.PREMISES_REQUIRED: This answer names no premises. Choose the premises the request concerns, then send again.
refusal.NOT_PARTY_TO_SUBJECT: Only a person who acts for the party that operated the premises when this record or answer was made can ask for it to be reconsidered. If you still do, check your delegation.
refusal.SUBJECT_SUPERSEDED: This record has been replaced by a newer version, so no request was sent. Read the version in force and send the request about it if needed. What you wrote is kept.
refusal.CHALLENGE_ALREADY_OPEN: This record or answer already has an unsettled request to reconsider it, so no second one was opened. Follow it in case {case}.
refusal.CASE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: RightOne could not read the case’s status, so this cannot be done. Try again in 5 minutes.
refusal.CASE_NOT_DECIDED: The case has not been decided, so the record cannot be corrected yet. The record stays as it is.
refusal.CASE_NOT_FOR_RECORD: This case did not come from a request to reconsider this record, so it cannot be used to correct it, and the record stays as it is. Check the case reference.
refusal.CORRECTION_NOT_REQUIRED: The case’s decision does not require a correction, so no new version was issued. The record stays as it is.
refusal.CORRECTION_ALREADY_RECORDED: The record was already corrected under this case in the version shown below, so no further version was issued.
refusal.INSPECTOR_STILL_APPOINTED: The inspector who opened it is still appointed or within the time allowed after the last day, so the authority cannot close it for them. Let them conclude, or wait until the suspension or appointment ends.
